# 智能助理已移除 / AI Assistants Removed

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/leader_events_1.txt:1038-1064

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 改变政策时（on_policy_changed，00_on_actions.txt:2532）：刚改的是人工智能政策且现为“禁用AI”，且有领袖带有智慧AI助手特质。
  On a policy change (on_policy_changed, 00_on_actions.txt:2532): the policy changed was the AI policy and is now "AI outlawed", and some leader has the Sapient AI Assistant trait.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「AI助手被移除」：移除所有领袖的智慧AI助手特质。
  "AI Assistants Removed": removes the Sapient AI Assistant trait from every leader.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 单个窗口，选项只带来效果，无后续事件。
  One window; the options only apply effects, no follow-up events.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 除触发条件所列外无额外文明差异。
  No further empire variants beyond the trigger conditions listed.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
